text: In this space, I am surrounded by modernity and emptiness—the architecture feels purposeful yet impersonal, as if made for gatherings that are yet to happen. The lighting is crisp, the glass reflective of my presence, yet the silence is palpable. Entering the next room, I am greeted by a lively burst of color and text about research and development. The shift from sterile stillness to vibrant curiosity stirs a sense of anticipation within me; here, human creativity meets the future, and a subtle excitement about innovation replaces my previous detachment. I feel the pulse of progress and possibility.
